Proposed amendment to the Constitution by the Legislature relating to taxation: Prohibits taxes or fees based on vehicle miles traveled and laws monitoring or limiting vehicle miles traveled without consent.

Proposed amendment to the Constitution by the Legislature relating to election requirements: Requires all voters, including voters who vote by mail, to show government-issued ID to vote in each election; makes other changes to election administration and campaign finance prohibitions.

Referred to the people by the Legislature relating to municipal transaction privilege tax: Retroactively prohibits local governments from adopting or increasing a tax on groceries without voter approval and sets a maximum rate of 2%.

Referred to the people by the Legislature relating to the Arizona Department of Homeland Security: Declares that drug cartels are terrorist organizations; directs the Arizona Department of Homeland Security to do everything in its authority to address drug cartels.

Referred to the people by the Legislature relating to photo enforcement systems: Prohibits state agencies and local governments from using photo enforcement systems for traffic enforcement unless provided by contract as of December 31, 2026; requires local governments to obtain voter approval to continue their use.

Referred to the people by the Legislature relating to school district budgets: Requires certain school districts to spend at least sixty percent of their operational spending on direct instructional expenses as defined by the Auditor General; reduces certain state funding for non-compliant districts.
